'''Sitost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Taris|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], she was stationed at the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Sitost first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Social Items vendor for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" />
With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was removed from the game along with the rest of the vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
